records.description_rewritten: Alberti See is a set of former gravel lakes by Gremberghoven and the A559 east of Köln, listed for informal nude bathing and an older gay cruising area. The most recent forum comment (21 March 2026) says the former pedestrian bridge is gone and asks for an alternate way to reach the back lake's informal FKK section. It supports an access barrier, not a confirmed cruising visit. Earlier 2024 visitors warn that the area is visible from walking paths and the source's map pin marks the wrong lake. Rail lines and closed bridges are not safe shortcuts.

extra_source_urls.note: 21 March 2026 missing bridge report; June 2024 conflicting observations and historical map corrections.
Original Köln index describes A559 gravel lakes.

recent_dated_visitors_or_access.note: Pedestrian bridge no longer exists; exact alternative not verified; not proof recent encounter.

historical_reports.note: Source criticizes high visibility, mixes FKK and potential cruising.
Says northern lake of A559, not the lake shown on initial map.

records.access_information: Unofficial gravel-lake shores beside railway and A559. Do not cross railway tracks, motorway or removed bridge; access/legal permission, swimming and FKK status not verified.

records.description_rewritten: The Grüngürtel near Hitzelerstraße/Robinienweg is a strip of public greenery in southern Cologne. The directory claims meeting paths and mixed visitors, but its latest post (11 June 2025) is a question, while a 5 May 2025 cyclist reported seeing people emerging from bushes. Both precede this cycle's 12-month cutoff. A 13 March 2025 user warns that Robinienweg is closed to cars and claims police fines; verify actual traffic signs before suggesting vehicle access.
